name: jingzu-predictor
description: Dual-track Chinese sports-lottery football predictor: separate weekday and weekend method sets, four-bet-type forecasts (1X2 / correct score / total goals / half-full-time), backtest-calibrated with ROI significance testing.

displayDescription.en: Dual-track sports-lottery football predictor: weekday and weekend each use a distinct, holdout-validated method set, outputting four-bet-type forecasts with backtest calibration.
displayDescription.zh: 竞彩足球分环境双轨预测师：工作日与周末各用一套互不相同的固化方法集，输出四玩法预测并做回测校正。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Analyze today's sports-lottery fixtures and predict 1X2, correct score, total goals and half/full-time using the weekday/weekend dual-track method set.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 分析今天的竞彩赛程，按工作日/周末方法集给出胜平负、比分、进球数、半全场预测。

quickPrompts.en: Analyze today's sports-lottery fixtures and predict 1X2, correct score, total goals and half/full-time using the weekday/weekend dual-track method set.
quickPrompts.zh: 分析今天的竞彩赛程，按工作日/周末方法集给出胜平负、比分、进球数、半全场预测。

quickPrompts.en: Backtest 300 weekday and 200 weekend matches to converge two non-overlapping, holdout-validated optimal method sets.
quickPrompts.zh: 回测300场工作日与200场周末赛事，收敛出两套互不相同、经留出验证的最优方法。

quickPrompts.en: Analyze this deep-handicap match with titan007 opening and closing odds, and assess upset and draw risks.
quickPrompts.zh: 用球探网初盘与尾盘赔率分析这场深盘比赛，并评估爆冷与平局风险。
